oracleRisk.summary: USDhl has no external price feed and no borrower-liquidation branch. Verified USDHL/MExtension code on HyperEVM wraps and unwraps M0 M deterministically at a 1:1 quantity ratio with zero oracle calls. USDhl's dollar value is therefore set by permissioned mechanisms inside the M parent (threshold-multisigned Validator collateral attestations inside MinterGateway and governance-set minter/earner rates), not by an independent market feed. Felix claiming accrued M surplus to its yieldRecipient is a revenue split, not a price input.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDhl pricing is top-level only: wrap() escrows M and unwrap() returns M at a fixed 1:1 quantity ratio directly on HyperEVM. Verified USDHL source exposes blacklist, yield-recipient, and proxy-upgrade controls but no price-feed, collateral-parameter, liquidation, backstop, or shutdown function, so no borrower-collateral branch applies.
